collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TALL TALES AND SELF-INTEREST (TT-01 to TT-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Boasting, stretched stories, little vanities, wanting the credit, the best seat or the bigger half. Most of it is harmless and funny; kind people can be boastful too. Nobody is exposed for the sake of it, and nobody needs a lesson.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager has a new shell-braided hairstyle and nobody has said a word: a friend notices, or a friend does not.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has done (subject.his/her) hair in a new way: braided, with little shells woven in. It took all morning. It looks wonderful. Nobody has said a word. (subject) has started standing where the light catches the shells, turning (subject.his/her) head a great deal, and has asked (friend) twice whether there's "anything different about today."

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Oh! Your hair!" says (friend) at last. (subject) looks surprised. "This? Oh, it's nothing." Then (subject.he/she) explains every step of how it was done, which shells, and why. (friend) listens to all of it. It really does look wonderful.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) looks closely, thinks hard, and says, "...Have you washed your sandals?" (subject) gives up and heads home. On the way, (child), a small child, stops dead in the path and says, "Your HAIR is so PRETTY." (subject) walks the rest of the way home a good deal taller.
